scope_statement: Mechanical census only. No production code, no runtime binder, no semantic inference, no M10/M11 change, no existing M12 record change, no Git write. No candidate is called executable and no binder is implemented.

population.join_rule: (AvatarConfig.AvatarID, AvatarSkillConfig.SkillTriggerKey) == same-owner CharacterConfig.SkillList[].Name, exact string equality

classification_rules.authority: mechanical; derived only from the compiler's own recorded fields
classification_rules.traversal_policy: top-level operations only; at most one TriggerAbility hop; multiple named targets stop the candidate (per the brief)
classification_rules.A: REF02 settlement op in the root body; compile_status != REJECTED; no REJECT_NOT_NOOP; no BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET; no random Retarget; no reference_execution_blocker; every non-settlement op is benign scaffolding
classification_rules.B: same as A but the settlement body is reached through exactly one explicit named content edge
classification_rules.C: REF02 settlement op present; no blocking condition; every non-settlement op is disposition EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE
classification_rules.D: REF02 settlement op present but at least one of: compile_status_REJECTED, REJECT_NOT_NOOP, BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET, reference_execution_blocker, random_retarget, multiple_settlement_ops, or a non-runtime-input non-settlement operation
classification_rules.E: no REF02-relevant settlement operation in the selected body, or no body selectable
classification_rules.note: CLASS_E here is gated on the two REF02 packet shapes only (damage/heal). Bodies whose only commerce-shaped operation is a resource or toughness operation are therefore also E; the resource and toughness features are counted separately in feature_counts.

natasha_reference_position.reason_for_rank: Ranks 2nd on mechanical merit, not by special-casing: 3 blocking categories (compile_status_REJECTED, REJECT_NOT_NOOP, BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET) and 8 operations versus Bailu 121101's 2 blocking categories and 4 operations. It is the only HEAL_REQUEST body in the whole population, and its heal operation is the only settlement operation anywhere that the compiler marks MODELLED with an EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE disposition.

new_exact_evidence_found.item: Only 7 of the 528 behavior-root-bound skills reach a body containing a REF02-relevant operation (1 HEAL_REQUEST, 6 DAMAGE_REQUEST); every one of the 7 is CLASS_D_STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED.

427 of 528 EntryAbility roots are compile_status REJECTED and 429 of 528 bodies carry at least one REJECT_NOT_NOOP blocker, so the dominant constraint is compiler rejection, not the absence of a settlement operation.
94 bodies have zero blockers, yet none of them contains a REF02 settlement operation: cleanliness and settlement shape never co-occur in this population.
No repository artifact maps any operation type or compiler kind to a PacketKind (all eight pairwise searches return 0 non-audit files).
Avatar_Bailu_00_Skill01_Phase02 (avatar 1211, SkillID 121101, trigger Skill01) is mechanically the least-blocked settlement-bearing body: 2 blocking categories, 4 operations, 1 DAMAGE_REQUEST.

305 of 528 roots name more than one top-level TriggerAbility target, so the brief's single-hop rule stops them; 288 of those roots are already REJECTED. The census is therefore not exhaustive over bodies reachable beyond the first named edge.

recommended_next_task: Mechanically widen the census rather than deepen the current one: for the 7 settlement-bearing bodies, enumerate the exact blocking operations and determine whether any of the three recurring blockers (WaitAnimState REJECT_NOT_NOOP, AddModifier EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_ADD_MODIFIER_ARGUMENTS_UNSUPPORTED, random Retarget) is covered by an existing compiler policy that would let it be excluded without new semantics; and separately, for the 305 ambiguous roots, enumerate each named TriggerAbility target and record how many of them reach a settlement-bearing body, so the census becomes exhaustive over first-hop bodies. Do not derive a formula, invent ParamList meaning, guess a packet kind, cost, target type or Dispel semantics, and do not traverse or execute any TriggerAbility edge.
